Choose what appears on your card and in shared contact data.
Manage your profile and cover images.
Permanently remove this profile and its local data.
Confirming permanently removes the saved profile and associated local profile data, including images, appearance, visibility settings, and public key. External backup files are not deleted.

Saved data cannot be verified and remains preserved. Retry verification or explicitly restore a verified application backup when recovery is available. No reset or older-profile fallback has occurred.

Existing local data is unavailable, not empty. Confirming makes this backup’s complete profile active and preserves the unavailable data privately as recovery evidence. It will not be used automatically. Cancel leaves existing data unchanged. Retained evidence uses internal storage and does not expire automatically.

Your confirmed deletion is incomplete. The profile cannot be displayed, edited, or shared. Retry to finish removing its app-managed local data. External backups and recipients’ contacts are not removed. This is not a promise of secure physical erasure.
Profile use and replacement are blocked. Retry resumes only a verified, previously confirmed operation. Invalid or contradictory operation evidence is preserved; it does not authorize a reset.
Add your name to start. Your profile stays on this device until you save it.
Changes appear on My Card after you save.
Card visibility and contact sharing are independent.
Your name always appears on your card and contact export.
These settings are part of your profile draft. Save Profile to apply changes.
Choose which details appear on your card.
Choose which details are shared through the contact QR and contact file.
Your full name is required and cannot be hidden.

Optional name components can improve contact import on Android and iPhone. Enter them yourself; they do not change your full name. Enable their Contact Export controls to share them. Profiles without shared name components may import differently on some cameras.
Select phone country or region. %1$s, calling code +%2$s.
Your saved number stays unchanged. This only changes how it appears in the contact QR and file.
Add a valid phone number to preview its shared format.
This saved number could not be formatted. Its existing digits will be preserved in the contact export.
Images and public keys are not included in contact export.
This URL points to an existing public page. VCard Native does not publish or host it.
Leave without saving this profile draft? Your saved profile will not change.
Review the normalized values below, then select Save profile again to commit. No data has been saved yet.
Unsaved drafts survive screen rotation, but are not saved to disk and may be lost if Android terminates the app.
Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 20 MiB. Images are prepared privately and saved with your profile.
Images are changed in Edit Profile. Save appearance separately.
Choose a card style, theme and accent, then save to apply. Your profile details are never changed here.
Your appearance changes haven\'t been saved.
Full Name is always shown. Choose up to four more items.
Maximum reached. Clear an item to choose another.
Items marked “Not shown” have no saved value or are hidden on your card. They stay selected, still count toward the four-item limit, and appear automatically once they have a visible value.
Sets Dark, Sapphire, Classic and no Minimal items. Nothing is saved until you select Save.
Web-profile QR and URL sharing are not available yet.
Create a contact file from your saved profile without a network connection.

Contact-only vCard 3.0: images, public keys, hosted profile URL and appearance are never included. Only export-enabled saved fields appear here. Card display settings are independent. Location and biography become labeled notes; repeated identical URLs are combined. Structured name parts are left empty rather than guessed; recipient import fidelity can vary.
This is what someone receives when you share your contact.
Review this saved contact before creating and sharing a .vcf file. Nothing is shared until you confirm below.
Read-only review of your saved export selections. Closing this preview creates no file.
Save a profile before sharing a contact. No sample contact or file has been created.
Works offline. Scan this contact QR with a compatible scanner. Included contact information is listed below; no VCard Native installation is required on the receiving device.
Offline contact QR for saving this contact.
Contact QR exceeds the 4,096-byte resource limit. Edit export selections and save, or share the complete contact file. No fields were dropped.
The complete contact does not fit QR versions 1–40 at correction M. Edit export selections and save, or share the contact file. No reduced QR was created.
The saved contact QR could not be encoded. Retry loading or edit export selections. No fallback code is displayed.
This QR cannot fit the available panel with readable modules and quiet zone. Edit export selections and save, or share the contact file. No undersized code is displayed.
Saving or sharing a QR image is not available yet. Present the on-screen QR or share the contact file.

Import a supported ASCII-armored public-only OpenPGP certificate up to 64 KiB. Private keys are rejected.
Manage an OpenPGP public key for identity verification. Private keys are not stored or supported.
Your profile is stored on this device. Add your details to create a shareable contact card.
Start with your name. Title and organization are optional.
Add contact details to share, or skip this step and add them later.
Check your details before creating your card. Nothing is saved until you choose Create My Card.
The fingerprint identifies the key, not its owner. Keys are never included in contact sharing.
Create or restore a profile backup.
Backup files are unencrypted and may include private or hidden details, photos, and key identities. Keep them secure.
Choose where to save your backup.
No saved profile is available to back up. You can still restore a complete application backup.
Review the backup before replacing your saved profile. Nothing changes until you confirm.
Preparing a coherent saved-data backup. Please wait; saved local data is unchanged.
Choosing the backup destination. Cancel returns without changing saved local data.
Finishing the backup file write. Navigation is temporarily unavailable until the output closes.
Choosing a backup to validate. Cancel leaves saved local data unchanged.
Checking the complete backup. Please wait; saved local data is unchanged.
Replacing saved local data and verifying the committed state. Navigation is temporarily unavailable while this operation finishes.
Confirmation replaces the entire local profile, images, appearance, visibility and public key. Existing unsaved work and sharing previews will not be carried over. There is no undo.
This file-supplied name is not independently verified identity or authorship.
